title: narcissus major var. maximus
intro: Narcissus major var. maximus, commonly known as the 'Large-flowered Daffodil', is a type of flowering bulbous perennial plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus major var. maximus include its sedative and anxiolytic effects, which can help in treating conditions such as insomnia, anxiety disorders, and depression. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, particularly galantamine, a cholinesterase inhibitor that has been used in the treatment of Alzheimer's disease.
